theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 정점 논쟁 + 중국 수출 규제 변동성. 어닝 미스 시 30% 낙폭 흔함.

theme_rankings.risk: 광고·소비 둔화 시 Capex 가이던스 컷 가능. 빅테크 동반 변동성.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🚂 AI의 '밴더빌트' — 실제 업무에 AI 박는 운영자
theme_rankings.why_now: 추론 비용 90% 하락 + 엔터프라이즈 도입 본격. 진짜 텐베거 후보가 여기서 다수.
theme_rankings.risk: 밸류에이션 과열. 매출 성장 30%+ 못 보이면 멀티플 압축.

theme_rankings.why_now: 인지노동 다음은 물리노동. 2027~2030 진정한 텐베거 가능 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 상용화 시점 불확실. 미래 옵션밸류 비중 큼. 변동성 극심.

theme_rankings.why_now: 강한 추세장에서만 사용. 분할매수 + 손절선 명확히 + 자산의 5~10% 이하.
theme_rankings.risk: 장기 보유 ❌. 횡보·하락장에선 음의 복리(volatility decay)로 손실 누적.

top_news.title: Gold Steady as Fed Official’s Remarks Temper Rate-Hike Bets
top_news.summary: Gold held a two-day decline after a Federal Reserve official signaled one more interest-rate hike may be needed this year, but further tightening won’t be necessary in 2027, improving sentiment toward the precious metal.

top_news.title: South Africa Fund Manager Tips Nigerian Stocks Over South Korea
top_news.summary: Allan Gray Ltd., which oversees $29 billion in assets, favors Nigerian stocks over South Korean equities, as they offer a diversification play from the artificial-intelligence frenzy that has swept markets from Wall Street to Asia.

top_news.title: Asia’s Coal Appetite Endures as Winter Looms and Supply Tightens
top_news.summary: Asian thermal coal prices have surged to a two-year high as power plants stockpile fuel for winter, tightening a market already strained by elevated demand and supply disruptions from China to Indonesia.

top_news.title: World-Beating China Bonds Can Overcome Paltry Yields, Funds Say
top_news.summary: China’s world-beating bonds have dodged the selloff in global debt and some fund managers are positioning for further gains due to a strong yuan and a sluggish domestic economy.

top_news.title: Glencore Set for ASX Debut in Test of Mining Giant’s Allure
top_news.summary: Glencore Plc begins trading on the Australian Securities Exchange on Wednesday after a listing that didn’t involve selling new shares or raising funds, in a test of the company’s ability to attract cash from a fresh pool of capital.

top_news.title: Rio Tinto Maintains Copper Output as Iron Ore Sales Increase
top_news.summary: Rio Tinto Group’s copper production remained steady in the third quarter as a strong performance at its Mongolian mine offset declines elsewhere, while shipments of iron ore rose marginally.

top_news.title: Major US Power Grids Strain Under Heat During Peak Repair Season
top_news.summary: Power supplies are tightening on grids that serve roughly one-third of the US population, as a short-lived blast of heat in the Midwest and Mid-Atlantic collides with planned off-season maintenance outages.

top_news.title: Citadel Securities’ Rubner Says Retail Traders Return to AI Bets
top_news.summary: Skittish retail investors are coming back around to their favorite bet: artificial intelligence.

top_news.title: We're upgrading our rating on Wells Fargo as the stock's pullback offers a nice entry point
top_news.summary: Wells Fargo's third-quarter results were not perfect, but CEO Charlie Scharf's turnaround should bear more fruit ahead.

top_news.title: J&J's 6% slide on an imperfect quarter is a gift to prospective buyers
top_news.summary: J&J's pharmaceutical division is humming along, and the MedTech problems should be temporary.
